{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America condemns the perpetrator of the mass killing and wounding of innocents at the LGBTQ night club Pulse in Orlando Florida this past weekend on Latin night.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America stands in solidarity with the victims and their families and the LGBTQ and Latinx community of Orlando and beyond.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The mass killing was motivated by homophobia and hypermasculinity that characterizes fanatical ideologies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Fanatical ideologies include Islamist and Christian extremism and far-right anti-immigrant and anti-Muslim political movements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Violent extremists target those who do not conform to conservative and patriarchal conceptions of social life rather than attacking the actual sources of injustice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America condemns all authoritarian movements and extremist religions that favor imposing their ideologies through armed violence of the state or of vigilantes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America finds it hypocritical of the religious right to condemn the attack as one upon “American values” because the far right espouses a worldview that demonizes the LGBTQ community, immigrants and people of color.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America stands for the building of a democratic civil society that affirms the humanity of all.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Right’s hate campaign in favor of transphobic bathroom bills stands in stark opposition to Democratic Socialists of America’s commitment to building a democratic civil society that affirms the humanity of all.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
